title: Qwen Office Integrates with AutoNavi Store Management Expert Kit to Enhance Physical Store Site Selection and Operational Efficiency

content_html:
Recently, Qwen Office announced the integration of the Gaode Store Operation Expert Kit. This kit includes three expert capabilities: site selection consulting, mall insights, and store diagnosis, covering a total of 10 skills, aiming to provide users with an all-in-one service for store location selection and business analysis. This new feature was officially launched on September 18th. Users just need to add the corresponding kit in Qwen Office and complete the Gaode account authorization to achieve a full workflow from store location selection to daily business analysis.

With the continuous development of physical commerce, traditional manual methods of site selection and business analysis have become inefficient and prone to errors. Individual entrepreneurs often need to spend a lot of time conducting on-site inspections, which can take up to a week. Meanwhile, when monitoring changes in store popularity and competitor dynamics, merchants face problems such as tedious data organization and inaccurate analysis results. Additionally, store managers often struggle to make precise decisions in areas like sales changes and inventory preparation due to a lack of data support.

To address these pain points, the Gaode Store Operation Expert Kit launched by Qwen Office provides users with scientific analytical tools to help improve store operational efficiency. The Site Selection Consulting Expert mainly targets chain brands and individual entrepreneurs. Based on Gaode's five-dimensional site selection model, it evaluates the rationality of store locations from multiple dimensions such as competition among similar stores, transportation convenience, and commercial maturity, and generates a complete business plan report that includes market analysis, investment budget, profit and loss calculations, and risk conclusions.

In addition, the Mall Insights Expert can generate detailed mall reports, analyzing the foot traffic changes, coverage area, and industry structure of individual malls, providing important basis for business attraction positioning and industry adjustment. The Store Diagnosis Expert, based on Gaode's spatiotemporal big data, provides comprehensive scores, rankings of similar stores, trends in foot traffic changes, and other multi-dimensional business reports, along with actionable improvement plans to help merchants develop more effective business strategies.

It is reported that a partner of a catering store in Baoding, Hebei Province, completed address analysis in just one hour at home after using the Site Selection Consulting Expert Kit, effectively filtering out low-rated addresses and significantly improving the efficiency of site selection.

Qwen Office is an enterprise-level intelligent assistant product launched by Alibaba. Since its launch, the user base has exceeded 30 million, with more than half being enterprise users. In the future, Qwen Office will continue to enrich its expert kits, providing more merchants with comprehensive business solutions.
